command: Implement the production KV basic path: decode KV_ALLOC/KV_APPEND/KV_GATHER/KV_FREE roots, stage BF16 K/V, and emit pinned iDMA/AXI requests. First freeze the used iDMA backend boundary and exact KV descriptor/address trace, then add randomized-ready RTL append/read/free and completion tests. Bind all builds/tests to CPU 8-25 and start only above 10 GiB MemAvailable.
success_condition: Single-sequence BF16 append/read/free matches the Python KV model bit-exactly; iDMA/AXI address, length, byte-enable, response and event traces are ordered and lossless under randomized backpressure; no leak/stale read/error completion releases a wait; upstream iDMA remains clean.
failure_policy: Do not substitute the clean-room KV engine for pinned iDMA transport evidence, hand-write a partial AXI protocol, bypass typed descriptors, relax BF16 exactness, or mark L2 PASS before consolidated Matrix/AHA/KV-iDMA evidence closes.
